purpose: Cover US-207 (every viewer text and control colour pair meets WCAG 2.1 AA in both themes): a static CSS-contrast audit parses `src/view/style.css`, resolves the `--sv-*` tokens for the light (`:root`) and dark (`:root[data-theme="dark"]`) blocks, enumerates every rule that sets `color` paired with a reachable background, walks state variants (default, :hover, :focus, :focus-visible, :active, [aria-pressed=true], [aria-selected=true], .is-active, :disabled) and asserts the WCAG 2.1 AA thresholds (>= 4.5:1 for text, >= 3:1 for large text and non-text UI boundaries); the test exits non-zero on any failure, naming selector, state, theme, foreground, background, computed ratio and threshold. Points at test/view/contrast-aa.test.js and the BEFORE/AFTER report at ./output/contrast-report.md captured during the lane work (w-2026-10-04-dave-001).
title: WCAG 2.1 AA contrast audit across the viewer stylesheet, both themes, every state

testCases.description: The audit parses `src/view/style.css`, enumerates every selector that sets `color` with every reachable background (own rule, ancestor surface token, page background `--sv-paper`) in each state (default, :hover, :focus, :focus-visible, :active, [aria-pressed=true], [aria-selected=true], .is-active, :disabled) in both the light and dark token sets, computes the WCAG relative-luminance ratio and asserts >= 4.5:1 for normal text and >= 3:1 for large text and non-text UI boundaries (WCAG 1.4.3 and 1.4.11).
testCases.testPointer: test/view/contrast-aa.test.js::enumerates every color/background pair and asserts WCAG 2.1 AA in both themes (AC-207-1)

testCases.description: When a contrast pair is below the threshold, the test failure message names the selector, state, theme, foreground colour, background colour, computed ratio and applied threshold; the test exits non-zero so the suite blocks a merge that drops below AA.
testCases.testPointer: test/view/contrast-aa.test.js::failure message names selector/state/theme/fg/bg/ratio/threshold and exits non-zero (AC-207-2)
